title: World Bank India: prospective institutional metadata cohort

resolutionWindow.selection: First complete independently archived official API capture whose first retained page retrieval is on or after opensAt and whose last retained page retrieval is no later than closesAt.
resolutionWindow.interpretation: Outcome is the metadata state at that capture, not proof of an event before April 6 or of any transition that occurred and was reversed between captures.

targetDefinitions.negative: Observed recognized status is Active, Dropped or Pipeline.
targetDefinitions.meaning: API lifecycle status; not verified physical completion or service quality.

targetDefinitions.positive: Observed valid closing date is later than baseline closing date.
targetDefinitions.negative: Both dates exist and observed date is equal to or earlier than baseline.
targetDefinitions.meaning: Recorded closing-date revision; not itself evidence of construction delay or wrongdoing.

targetDefinitions.positive: Observed current total commitment exceeds baseline current total commitment.
targetDefinitions.negative: Both nonnegative amounts exist and observed amount is equal to or lower than baseline.
targetDefinitions.meaning: Metadata commitment revision; not a payment, loss, cash receipt or beneficiary identification.

variableDefinitions.label: Recorded project status
variableDefinitions.interpretation: API status, not independently verified physical completion.

variableDefinitions.label: Recorded closing date
variableDefinitions.interpretation: Current metadata date; original approval baseline is not established.

variableDefinitions.label: Current total commitment
variableDefinitions.interpretation: Commitment metadata, not disbursed cash, loss or traced payment.

limits: Failed fetch, missing project, unrecognized status, missing required field or no eligible capture means unknown, never a negative outcome.
No historical corruption classifier or calibrated probability is available.
collector and resolver implemented; no recurring job or future collection execution is claimed
